environment_profiles.reference_prompt: A 3D animated, Pixar-style futuristic cyberpunk rooftop dance floor at night. The scene features a glowing holographic dance floor with pulsing geometric patterns in vibrant magenta and electric cyan. In the background, soft-focused futuristic skyscrapers with warm, golden window lights stretch into a deep indigo sky. Whimsical warm string lights hang overhead, casting a cozy and inviting glow. Hovering DJ booths and plush, semi-stylized lounge pods are scattered around the edges, surrounded by gently glowing futuristic plants. The atmosphere is energetic yet heartwarming, rendered with soft textures, rich volumetric lighting, and a warm, cinematic depth of field.
